The [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] and [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] working for the [[Dread Host]] maintained a '''forward assault camp''' northeast of [[Camp Overlook]] in [[Section X]], a region of the [[Belsavis prison]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The forward assault camp appears in Section X, a Daily Area added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in Game Update 1.5.<ref name="TOR" />
